tasks.notes: Documents-only amendment of packages/eng-harness/docs/specs/0003-calcs.md (section 4.7 and its acceptance criteria) and plans/0003-calcs.md, from the lead findings of the reviews and adversarial verifications of calcs T8 (pull request 305, merged: read its Review section) and T8b (review record <lead>/reports/b460-review.md; the T8b draft is in the worktree <worktrees>/b460, read-only for you). Make exactly these edits: (1) DEFECT, reproduced by the T8b reviewer: D2 keys carry no list name, so in model.load_set/1 a load pattern and a combination with the same name (or a frame load and an area load with equal ids), and in model.sections/1 a frame section and an area section with the same name, give two changes with the same (section, key); DiffBody then refuses the report ('changes must be sorted and unique') and the CalcPort reports INTERNAL, so AC24 fails for such inputs. Decide it in the spec with the smallest rule consistent with the rest of section 4.7 and the kind `harness.model_diff` in kinds/calcs.py: the key is prefixed with the name of the list the row comes from (state the exact form and the sort order that follows); add an acceptance criterion with its test name for the collision case. (2) D2 says a duplicated key 'is counted as a change unless both sides are byte-identical', which contradicts AC28 ('never reported as unchanged') and D7: amend D2 to the rule of AC28 and D7, which the merged code follows. (3) Record the representation choices the merged comparison core made and reviewers accepted, as spec sentences without new behaviour: a null key member (combination item case.step) is left out of the key; a member absent on one side is read as null; section-level members are reported under key []; a known quantity kind with no tolerance in the mapping compares exactly (D4); the tagged-type rule of D4 applies to nested objects only. (4) Section 4.7 describes before and after as groups and AC48 writes before=<refs>, but the CalcPort resolves only top-level references, so the calc takes flat before_<section> and after_<section> inputs: say so. (5) Plan prose (section 2, the T7 to T12 paragraph): the D2 keys live in calcs/_compare.py, not _state.py (which is in the hash closure of harness.model_fingerprint). (6) Plan: one new task T8c after T8, before T8b: 'Difference keys carry their list (comparison core and the diff kind)', files calcs/_compare.py, kinds/calcs.py if the kind's key rule changes, their tests, CHANGELOG, the schema snapshot if the kind changes; tests_first inside the task; covers the new acceptance criterion; depends_on T8; T8b depends_on T8c; a realistic small budget. T8c will be work item B-470. Keep to these edits (D-28). Invent no tolerance or engineering value. The pull request body line is `Plan-Task: none (spec and plan)`.
